//: Generates the published type declarations from the JSDoc already in the sources — same shape as
the core package's build. Nothing is compiled: `emitDeclarationOnly` means the .js ships exactly
as written and only .d.ts files are produced, and `checkJs` stays off deliberately, because this
build exists to describe the framework to consumers rather than to type-check it.
`bin/static` is excluded: those are browser assets served to a page, not part of the module API.
Run with `npm run build:types -w @ti-engine/web-framework`. The output is committed, because the
publish job deliberately runs no install and no lifecycle scripts.
